title: Session route catalog matcher emptiness aligned with C# resolver semantics
limitations: Schema/spec alignment only; no runtime behavior change.
C# catalog remains the authoritative resolver implementation; empty matchers are ignored during resolution.
notes: Matcher fields now accept an empty string as absent, reject control characters via explicit Unicode ranges, and anyOf requires at least one non-whitespace matcher. This matches the C# catalog that already saves and resolves this shape.
